subject.title: fix(hooks): wire message:sending internal hook to user-defined hooks

question: Should user-defined `message:sending` observers receive the original attempted content before plugin policy, or only the final content after rewrite and cancellation policy accepts delivery?
rationale: This determines whether audit hooks may observe sensitive content that a modifying security hook subsequently rejects, and the existing name does not independently settle that boundary.

options.title: Observe accepted content
options.body: Emit the internal notification after plugin policy succeeds, use the final rewritten payload, and emit nothing when delivery is cancelled.

options.title: Observe attempted content
options.body: Keep the pre-policy boundary but explicitly document and test that the event reports attempted rather than accepted outbound content.

recommendation.title: Observe accepted content
recommendation.body: Emit the internal notification after plugin policy succeeds, use the final rewritten payload, and emit nothing when delivery is cancelled.

likelyOwner.reason: Their active exactly-once channel-hook work is the closest owner-level treatment of this outbound security and delivery contract.
